rule: Controls: four moves (up, down, left, right). There is no use for an action button.
Walking into a crate pushes it one cell (Sokoban push); crates cannot be pulled.
A crate cannot be pushed into another crate or off the grid; the push is refused.
Floor colour restricts the player: a step from a white (light) tile onto a black (dark) tile, or from black onto white, is refused.
Grey tiles connect both colours: the player can step onto grey from white or black, and from grey onto white or black.
Pushing also depends on floor: a player on white/grey can push only a crate standing on white/grey, a player on black only a crate standing on black; otherwise the push is refused.
The crate itself is not restricted by colour: a pushed crate may move onto any floor colour (which changes who can push it next).
Win: when every crate is on a target (blue tile) the level is completed and the next level loads.
